## About Littlebird
Littlebird builds a personal memory layer for knowledge workers. Our product captures meeting notes, email threads and documents, then lets people ask questions across all of it with sub-second answers. We are a 22-person team backed by two top-tier seed funds.

## About the role
You will own the retrieval backend that powers search and question answering. Day to day that means designing Postgres schemas, tuning hybrid keyword and vector retrieval, and keeping p95 latency under 200 ms as customer corpora grow into the millions of documents.

## Responsibilities
- Design and ship backend services in Python and Go.
- Own ingestion pipelines: parsing, chunking, embedding and deduplication.
- Tune ranking quality using offline evaluation sets and online experiments.
- Improve reliability: on-call rotation shared across the backend team, roughly one week in six.

## Requirements
- 5+ years building production backend systems.
- Strong PostgreSQL skills, including indexing and query planning.
- Experience with search or retrieval systems (Elasticsearch, pgvector or similar).
- Comfortable with async Python and message queues.

## Nice to have
- Experience evaluating retrieval quality (recall@k, MRR).
- Prior work on LLM-powered products.

## Compensation and location
This role is fully remote from India, with a working-hours overlap of at least four hours with the Pacific time zone. Salary band is INR 55-80 lakh plus equity. We provide a home-office stipend and an annual learning budget.
